title: Pharmacological Inhibition of APT2 by Solasonine Promotes Ferroptosis Through Palmitoylation Modulation in Gallbladder Cancer.
authors: Shi, Liu-Qing; Zhao, Jing-Wei; Zhu, Jia-Yun; Zhao, Cheng; Yang, Zi-Yi; Pan, Li-Jia; Ma, Ben; Chen, Zheng-Yu; Wang, Zi-Ying; Li, Chun-Jie; Liu, Shi-Lei; Mei, Jia-Wei; Dong, Ping
one_liner_zh: 该文研究茄碱抑制APT2促进胆囊癌铁死亡，涉及STAT3棕榈酰化调控及下游GPX4/SLC7A11转录，但核心是药物机制与肿瘤治疗，蛋白质-DNA互作仅作为转录调控的间接环节，且无AI或物理模拟方法创新。
abstract: Gallbladder cancer (GBC), the most prevalent and lethal biliary tract malignancy, lacks effective therapeutic strategies. Solasonine (SS), a bioactive steroidal alkaloid derived from Solanum nigrum L, exhibits antitumor activity in multiple cancers, but its role in GBC and association with ferroptosis remains unknown. The purpose of this study is to investigate the therapeutic effects of SS on GBC and its underlying mechanisms using both in vitro and in vivo models. The efficacy was tested in subcutaneous models. Then, the anti-GBC effects of SS were assessed via CCK-8, colony formation, and EdU assays. Biosafety was evaluated using L-2F7 cells and murine serum biomarkers. RNA sequencing identified key pathways, validated by ChIP-qPCR and dual-luciferase reporter assays. Ferroptosis induction was confirmed by measuring MDA, GSH, ROS, Fe2+, qRT-PCR/Western blot (GPX4/SLC7A11), and rescue experiments. Direct binding of SS to APT2 was demonstrated through molecular docking, CETSA, and SPR. The study employed orthotopic xenograft models, transwell assays, and wound healing assays to investigate the effects of SS on the metastasis of GBC. SS triggered ferroptosis in GBC by elevating MDA, ROS, and Fe2+ while depleting GSH and downregulating GPX4/SLC7A11. Mechanistically, SS directly bound APT2, inhibiting its enzymatic activity and blocking STAT3 depalmitoylation. This prevented p-STAT3 nuclear translocation, suppressing transcription of ferroptosis inhibitors GPX4 and SLC7A11. In vivo, SS suppressed tumor growth by subcutaneous and orthotopic models with no systemic toxicity. Our findings reveal SS as a novel APT2-targeted ferroptosis inducer that inhibits GBC progression via inhibiting the depalmitoylation process of STAT3, providing a safe and effective therapeutic candidate for this intractable malignancy.
abstract_zh: 胆囊癌（GBC）是最常见且最致命的胆道恶性肿瘤，目前缺乏有效的治疗策略。茄碱（SS）是一种来源于龙葵（Solanum nigrum L）的生物活性甾体生物碱，在多种癌症中表现出抗肿瘤活性，但其在GBC中的作用及其与铁死亡（ferroptosis）的关联尚不清楚。本研究旨在利用体外和体内模型探讨SS对GBC的治疗效果及其潜在机制。在皮下模型中测试了其疗效。随后，通过CCK-8、集落形成和EdU实验评估了SS的抗GBC效果。使用L-2F7细胞和小鼠血清生物标志物评估了生物安全性。RNA测序鉴定了关键通路，并通过ChIP-qPCR和双荧光素酶报告实验进行了验证。通过测量MDA、GSH、ROS、Fe2+、qRT-PCR/Western blot（GPX4/SLC7A11）以及拯救实验确认了铁死亡的诱导。通过分子对接、CETSA和SPR证明了SS与APT2的直接结合。研究采用原位异种移植模型、transwell实验和伤口愈合实验来探讨SS对GBC转移的影响。SS通过升高MDA、ROS和Fe2+，同时消耗GSH并下调GPX4/SLC7A11，触发了GBC中的铁死亡。机制上，SS直接结合APT2，抑制其酶活性并阻断STAT3去棕榈酰化。这阻止了p-STAT3核转位，从而抑制了铁死亡抑制剂GPX4和SLC7A11的转录。在体内，SS通过皮下和原位模型抑制了肿瘤生长，且无系统性毒性。我们的发现揭示SS是一种新型靶向APT2的铁死亡诱导剂，通过抑制STAT3的去棕榈酰化过程来抑制GBC进展，为这种难治性恶性肿瘤提供了安全有效的治疗候选药物。
